route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81hd_ctl_m/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81hd_ctl_m/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81hd_ctl_m --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81hd_ctl --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: HD-CTLGATE (S81-HEAD 10-21): NEW head-die controller ot_s81hd_ctl (HD-CTL b4f571642: x store 80 kb in 4 x ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2, bus B stream, N/S final, rank merge, host / draft endpoints, XB forward, MU replay) as a FLAT leaf: dsfd_mtp_seq is synthesised in (its only closed views, dsfd_mtp_seq_b/_c 10-08, are MAXL M7 legacy views that a M5-cap cluster cannot bind; the M5 reroute is NEEDS_RTL). 19,016 signal pins -> pin-bound outline: N sn + mesh TX, S ss + mesh RX, E draft lanes, W lep ring + host lanes. MAIN: 1,036.8 square, the 4 x-store SRAMs (171.3 x 77.8, W/E data pins) in one centre column (x 432, 129.6 pitch, 51.8-um N/S gaps, wide W/E pin channels), pin flops in the face bands; k-means K=16.
